read.title: Label Check Before Printing
read.text:
Dear Mr. Nguyen,

Thank you for your order. Before we print the boxes, could you confirm whether our English label meets the cosmetics regulation in Vietnam? We understand that a Vietnamese label sticker may also be required.

Please find attached the label draft, including the full ingredient list and expiry date. If any changes are needed for compliance, please let us know in advance, as printing takes about ten days.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.task: 미국 바이어에게 신제품 라벨 시안을 보내면서, 현지 표기 규정에 맞는지 확인해 달라고 요청하는 이메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: Send a label draft to a U.S. buyer and ask them to confirm whether it meets local labeling rules.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Reed,

Please find attached the label draft for our new cleansing foam. Could you confirm whether it meets the labeling rules in the U.S.? If any changes are needed, please let us know in advance so we can update the file before printing.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
